title: Auburn, AL — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Auburn is a city in AL with a population of 82,000. College town with Southern charm, strong Auburn University presence, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.6.
